name: Website Steering Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  Video Teleconference
  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / City Website Steering Committee Meeting

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Thursday, March 7, 2024
  3:30 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  March 7, 2024 / 3:30 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Councilmember Lili Bosse, Councilmember John Mirisch, Deputy City
  Manager Keith Sterling, Community Outreach Manager Magdalena Davis,
  Public Information Manager Lauren Santillana

  1) Public Comment:

  None

  2) Presentation from Civic Plus:
  a. Remaining Key events:
  i. March 26: Website Reveal Meeting
  ii. Early April: Training
  iii. Late April: Launch
  b. Civic plus gave a presentation of what the current draft of the website looks like.
  c. The city is working with IT to have the most visited pages of the website easily
  accessible from the home page.
  d. The displayed draft currently lacks Ask BH, the under-development city centralized
  customer service, but it will be included in the final product.
  e. Also presented several options for internal and external redirects for
  Councilmember pages and social media posts.
  f. The second website option is greener and utilizes square buttons instead of
  circular ones.

  3) Discussion:
  a. Councilmember Bosse expressed concern with how long the home page is and
  how much scrolling is needed to find something.
  b. She also expressed concern over the timeline and is concerned about
  implementing the website without public input.
  c. Councilmembers Bosse & Mirisch also expressed their preference for the second
  website option.
 Highlights for March 7, 2024
City Website Steering Committee

  4) Next and Final Meeting – March 16, 2024:

  None

  5) Adjournment:
  Date / Time: March 7, 2024 / 3:51 PM
